strings.name: Achim Steiner
strings.summary: Steiner links environmental governance with international development. A former IUCN director-general, UNEP executive director and UNDP administrator, he worked on green economics, poverty reduction and sustainable-development coordination. After leaving UNDP in 2025, he became an Oxford Martin School senior fellow in 2026, studying interconnected climate, health, technology and geopolitical risks.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Previously led UNEP and UNDP, with long involvement in coordinating environmental, poverty-reduction and sustainable-development policies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Carazinho, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Undergraduate philosophy, politics and economics at Oxford; master’s in development-related studies at SOAS, University of London.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Environment and development leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led IUCN, UNEP and UNDP, linking ecology, economic transition and development policy.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Interconnected-risk research
strings.highlights.h2.text: Returned to Oxford to study security risks connecting climate, technology, health and geopolitics.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Returned to Oxford as senior fellow
strings.timeline.t1.text: Appointed an Oxford Martin School senior fellow, pursuing interconnected security and risk research.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Completed UNDP tenure
strings.timeline.t2.text: Completed two terms as UNDP administrator and left the agency.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became UNDP administrator
strings.timeline.t3.text: Succeeded Helen Clark at the UN Development Programme.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Directed Oxford Martin School
strings.timeline.t4.text: Led the school after leaving UNEP, until 2017.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Led UN Environment Programme
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became UNEP executive director, serving until 2016.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became IUCN director-general
strings.timeline.t6.text: Led the International Union for Conservation of Nature until 2006.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Led World Commission on Dams secretariat
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became secretary-general, contributing to assessments of dams and development.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Began development-cooperation career
strings.timeline.t8.text: Worked on rural regional development at Germany’s development-cooperation agency.
